lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: Makoto.
: Interesting choice. I’d like to hear your reasoning.
: First, I’d like to hear about when you decided to become a voyeur.
: It is my understanding that I was simply born one. Your turn.
: Access to all of the free porn a man could ever need.

: You’re choosing which one you’d prefer to bed at the moment, not interviewing marriage candidates.
: I’m sorry, Nodoka. Do you have an issue with my choice?
: My biggest issue is that this leaves me with one of the other two and neither one of them is particularly my type.
: Oh, my bad. I didn’t realize we were sharing.
: Apart from that, I’m mostly just curious as to how you wound up deviating from my script so much.
: I was positive this would come down to a battle of calico vs. golden retriever. I hadn’t even assigned an animal to Makoto yet.

: I apologize. I was unaware you knew so much about canine breeds.
: A person just picks certain things up after spending so much time in the doggystyle position.

: With all due respect, you are the last person I’d ever sell a living creature to.
: And why is that?
: Because I can’t imagine it would live for more than a week regardless of what species it is.
: I’ll have you know I already do care for two animals. A parrot and cat, to be specific.
: Yeah, sure. Imani told me she had a parrot and a cat once too.
: What an extremely odd coincidence.
: You’re free to believe whatever you like. Shall I inform Makoto to exit the shower and make her way to the room now?
: I can find some way to distract the other two.
: Please don’t. I went to go find Yumi since this was a choice I literally could not make in person.
: Ahh, so that’s the reason for the deviation. You’re off writing your own story again instead of following mine.
: Do I do that often?
: You and several others, yes. I’m not bothered, though. It keeps things interesting.
: Is Makoto good at sex, by the way?

: I assume she is given all of the practice and exposure, but she refuses to elaborate about any of her tactics to me. And this, unfortunately, forces me to make things up while I’m writing her scenes with you.
: Wait, you’re writing that book again? I thought you stopped?
: I did. These are for my personal collection.
: May I see this collection by any chance?
: Provide a detailed sexual analysis of her and I will allow you to look through mostly everything.
: Nice. That gives me something to do tonight while I avoid all of your vaginas.
: How sad. We’re all so wet too.
: You’re in the shower.
: That was the joke, yes.
: Oh.
: Don’t send me emojis. I don’t like them from you.
: Maya.
: So predictable, Akira.
: I understand where you’re coming from, though.
: It only makes sense to choose the most comfortable option when you stand to lose more than you stand to gain no matter which direction you choose.
: Ideally, I’d be able to get three doses of poison instead of just one. But alas.
: Sounds like you need to build up your immunity. So why have you left us?
: Things were just getting interesting.
: Too interesting. I was going to die if I stayed in that room any longer.
: Now, that’s not how the protagonist of a harem story should sound. If we can’t rely on you to take care of all of us, who else are we supposed to turn to?
: Normally, I’d suggest we take care of each other. But none of these girls are even half as interested in having sex with me as they are with you.
: I don’t think any of them are any amount of interested in having sex with you, Nodoka.
: I agree. And I believe this is evidenced by the sheer amount of candid photos I’ve been able to take of them while they’re showering.
: Yeah, so are you just huddled in the corner right now or something?
: Sitting on a shower bench, actually. I’m not even trying to hide what I’m doing.
: These girls could get into serious trouble being as oblivious as this. I sure hope nothing terrible happens to them.
: I sure hope that isn’t you alluding to literally doing something terrible to them.
: I’m just saying, I could just as easily be a strange man on this bench right now, snapping photos that I will use to pleasure myself in bed later tonight.
: Speaking of which, I assume you’ve already heard of the mysterious picture messages we all received in school recently, yes?
: Yes. But I’d appreciate it if you’d both delete them and also never speak of them.
: I already have. I didn’t find them particularly arousing. And Uta does not seem to like me as is, so I made an educated guess and assumed that possessing them would only exacerbate that.
: Why even bring it up then?
: Because I assume you are aroused and I would like to watch you have sex with one of my classmates in this shower.
: This is far more boring than I assumed it would be. And I’m getting good footage right now.
: I’m not coming back so you can film me having sex with your friends, Nodoka.
: I know that. I don’t believe any of them are my friends.
: I intend to film you having sex with Maya primarily as she was your first choice and I’d like to explore more of your dynamic together.
: Both physically and emotionally.
: No.
: Please?
: Put your phone down and go finish your shower. This isn’t normal behavior and you need to at least try to fit in with the rest of the squad.
: What if they don’t accept me, though?
: Then it’s probably your fault.
: Yes, I suppose you’re probably correct.
: Do you think they will notice if I attempt to pleasure myself on this bench?
: Why not try and let me know how it went?
: I’ve been caught.
: Well, that didn’t take long at all.

: dsfhjgvgasuzzzzzzzzzzzzz
: Hi, Makoto.
: DELTE THP ICTUREY OU ALRDY HAVNEOGH OF ME!!@@!!!!!!

: Ayane.
: Not Maya?

: I expected one of the two. I’d just like to confirm your reasoning as to why you chose who I assumed was the less likely recipient of your semen.
: I’m not sure I know how to put it into words. It’s just very difficult for me to not choose Ayane whenever she’s an option.
: Is this because you earnestly believe she is the correct choice? Or are you simply afraid of disappointing her?
: Can the answer be both?
: I suppose it can. I’m just curious as to how you feel about Maya then as I’m sure you’ve said something similar either to or about her in the past.
: I very likely have, yes. This was kind of an impossible decision, to be honest.
: And yet it was one you made.
: It was.
: Quite quickly at that.
: The baby factory thing got to me.
: She does have what appears to be quite the immaculate vagina from across the room.  Excellent physical form as well. I’d certainly agree with the notion that she is the most breedable among us.
: She is certainly a contender for “the girl I have emptied the most semen into over the last decade.”
: Just to clarify, when you say “decade,” you are referring to the bit of extended time that we are apparently trapped in, correct?

: I’ve always wished to be your first of something, but I will say that this is absolutely not the type of “first” I was expecting.

: I’ve amassed quite a few from this side of the spa. And my hands are rather steady as well, so several will have you feeling like you’re practically inside of her.
: I don’t need your candid photos, Nodoka. I have plenty of my own and can seize her body whenever I like.

: Me?
: Yeah. You’re hot too. Send me some pictures of yourself.
: I’m feeling strangely embarrassed right now.
: You’re really cute and I like you a lot.
: Please stop. I don’t like it.
: I can’t stop thinking about tenderly kissing you on the forehead right now.
: I need to go. Goodbye.
